verses.greek: Ἀκούσαντες δὲ ἀνάστασιν νεκρῶν οἱ μὲν ἐχλεύαζον οἱ δὲ εἶπαν Ἀκουσόμεθά σου περὶ τούτου καὶ πάλιν.
verses.literal: Having heard of now a resurrection of the dead some indeed were mocking him some however said We will hear you concerning this also again.
verses.dgt: Now when they heard of resurrection of the dead, some began mocking, but others said, “We will hear you about this again.”

verses.literal: Thus the Paul went out from the midst of them.
